中文功能定位: 在 ty-sysplorer-modeling-rules 之后，为明确指定、上下文或已有模型已选定，或父级依据标准库功能缺口补充的 TY 商业机械组件提供领域指导。保留标准库与商业库组合及其他已选领域；纯标准库或自建机械任务仍由父级处理。验证深度、图面证据和正式报告范围继承用户验收要求。
英文功能定位: After ty-sysplorer-modeling-rules, support TY mechanical components selected explicitly, in effective prior context or an existing model, or by the parent to fill evidenced standard-library gaps. Keep selected standard and cross-domain components. Pure standard-library/custom mechanical tasks remain with the parent. Inherit requested validation, diagram evidence and report scope.
